claims.text: SAM combines an image encoder, a prompt encoder, and a mask decoder to predict segmentation masks from images and prompts.
claims.notes: Sam stores all three components and its forward method feeds image and prompt embeddings into the mask decoder. This is a source-reviewed development annotation, not a verbatim PDF quotation. The original PDF could not be downloaded in this environment; no PDF page or character offsets have been invented.

claims.text: SAM represents point prompts with positional encodings and distinct learned embeddings for foreground and background points, and represents boxes using embeddings of their two corners.
claims.notes: PromptEncoder assigns separate nn.Embedding weights by point label and by box corner; coordinates pass through the positional encoder. claims.text: SAM encodes an input mask with a convolutional downscaling network and adds its dense embedding to the image embedding before mask decoding.
claims.notes: PromptEncoder downsamples masks through stride-two convolutions and projects to embed_dim; MaskDecoder adds dense_prompt_embeddings directly to image_embeddings. This is a source-reviewed development annotation, not a verbatim PDF quotation. The original PDF could not be downloaded in this environment; no PDF page or character offsets have been invented.

claims.notes: TwoWayAttentionBlock contains prompt self-attention, token-to-image attention, an MLP, and image-to-token attention, with residual updates to both streams.
